passage:
Woman: Good morning, Spring Air official ticket office, how can I help you?
Man: Hello, I'd like to book two tickets for the high-speed train from Shanghai to Guangzhou on the 31st of this month.
Woman: Of course. Which class would you like — first class or second class?
Man: Second class, please. And we'd prefer the earliest morning departure if possible.
Woman: Let me check. On the 31st there's a departure at 7:10 and another at 8:45. The 7:10 has only three seats left together; the 8:45 has plenty of availability.
Man: We'll take the 7:10 then. How long does the journey take?
Woman: About six hours and twenty minutes, with a quiet carriage and power sockets at every seat. Snacks are included, and if you download our app, you can also order hot meals delivered to your seat during the journey.
Man: That's convenient. How much is it for two?
Woman: Second class is 862 yuan per person, so that's 1,724 yuan total. If you take the 8:45 instead, there's a holiday promotion — 10 percent off bookings of two or more tickets.
Man: Hmm. 1,552 yuan for two on the 8:45 sounds tempting, but honestly, catching the 7:10 matters more — we need to prepare the New Year dinner before the evening rush.
Woman: No problem. Can I have the names as on your ID cards?
Man: Sure — Chen Wei and Chen Xiaoyu.
Woman: And a phone number for the booking?
Man: 138-2654-9012.
Woman: Right. Payment can be made now by card, or within 30 minutes via our app. I'm holding the seats for 15 minutes while you decide.
Man: Let's pay now. By the way — what about festive overcrowding at the station? I've heard it's chaos before the holiday.
Woman: It's busy, yes. We suggest arriving at least 40 minutes early. Security checks are strict, and the gates close five minutes before departure.
Man: Noted. One more thing — can we change to a different train later if plans change?
Woman: Yes, free of charge up to 15 days before departure; after that, a fee of 20 percent applies within 48 hours of departure.
Man: Understood. Please go ahead and charge my card.
Woman: All done. Your booking reference is SF-2031874. Have a safe trip, and happy New Year in advance!
Man: Thank you very much. Goodbye!
